_note: Example commands a user can make. None of these run on their own: they're starting points offered in Create Command and doit create. Verify each against the book before relying on it.

examples.explanation: Shows how full each drive is, in sizes that are easy to read.

examples.command: sudo pacman -Sy --needed archlinux-keyring cachyos-keyring && sudo pacman -Su
examples.explanation: Refreshes the package signing keys first, then updates everything installed. Keys go stale on a system that hasn't updated in a while, and installs fail until they're refreshed.
examples.warning: This updates your whole system, including the kernel. Take a snapshot first if you want an undo button.

examples.explanation: Saves a restore point you can roll back to if something breaks.
examples.warning: Only works if snapper is set up on this computer. If it isn't, this will fail with an error about a missing config.

examples.explanation: Installs the Brave browser using the installation command from Brave's own guide.
examples.warning: If Brave isn't in your regular repos, Brave's installer uses an AUR helper (paru, pikaur or yay) and installs from the AUR without asking again. It also refreshes your package list.
